sources.title: Macky Sall: public biographical preview, birth and education
sources.findings: Read the public Munzinger preview for birth on 11 December 1961 in Fatick, Dakar studies completed in 1988 and ENSPM studies completed in 1993. Do not claim access to the subscription biography. Its National Assembly endpoint is September 2008 while other records distinguish November removal; the public dossier uses only 2007–2008. No invented PhD, unsupported siblings count or exact initial party-membership date.

sources.title: IFP School Alumni Mag no. 271, October 2019: Sall alumni editorial
sources.findings: Read the cover and Sall editorial on printed page 5 of IFP School Alumni Mag no. 271, October 2019. Sall identifies himself as an alumnus who entered as a geological engineer and left as a petroleum engineer. This supports school attendance and training, not a doctorate. The editorial’s future oil-production date is an old forecast, not an actual start date. No full 48-page magazine or image-pixel review claimed.

sources.title: Macky Sall: historical speaker profile and first presidential accession
sources.findings: Read the World Bank speaker biography. It supports earlier PETROSEN and ministerial work, prime minister from 2004, Assembly presidency 2007–2008 and first presidential accession on April 2, 2012. The heading President is historical and not a current title. Retain year-only precision for the premiership; some indexed biographies conflict between April and July 2004. Do not invent a precise day or reuse the page as evidence of November 2026 activity.

sources.title: Career account: break with the PDS, APR founding and 2012 election
sources.findings: Read the career sections of the Macky Sall biography website, including the PDS break, December 1, 2008 APR creation and 2012 electoral victory. The founding month is independently supported by Munzinger; the exact day also appears in indexed contemporary RFI coverage and a signed letter reproduced elsewhere, whose full pages could not be retrieved. The site contains a stale President heading and conflicting education-year summaries; no assumption of current office, control of the site, or neutral appraisal. Promotional character assessments and personal-family details are not copied.

sources.title: Senegal Economic Update, December 2014: PSE launch and policy objectives
sources.findings: Read selected World Bank December 2014 Economic Update sections: February 2014 Paris launch at printed page 3, and PSE goals and investment assumptions at printed page 16. The 2035 emerging-economy goal and financing pledges are not demonstrated completion or sole personal achievement. The report cautions that assumptions are optimistic. No whole 46-page audit or current project-benefit evaluation claimed.

sources.title: Senegal’s referendum of contention, 31 March 2016
sources.findings: Read ISS’s March 31, 2016 account of the completed March 20 referendum and the Constitutional Council opinion affecting the existing term. Five-year terms did not retroactively reduce the first seven-year presidency. The reported 62.7% is a provisional result and is not promoted to a certified final percentage in the public text. Critical analysis is attributed, not treated as a court judgment.

sources.title: Constitutional Council confirms Sall’s 2019 re-election
sources.findings: Read Xinhua’s report published March 6 describing the March 5 final Constitutional Council result for the February 24 election. Use 2,555,426 valid votes and 58.26%, not earlier 58.27% preliminary figures. Its April 2 inauguration was still prospective at publication; no claim this report itself witnessed that ceremony. Second-term length five years is distinct from the first seven-year term.

sources.title: Sall takes over as AU Chairperson, 5 February 2022
sources.findings: Read the AU’s February 5, 2022 takeover announcement. Sall replaced Félix Tshisekedi as rotating AU Chairperson at the heads-of-state summit in Addis Ababa. This is not the AU Commission chairmanship, whose then holder Moussa Faki Mahamat appears separately. The outgoing leader’s achievements and speech are not assigned to Sall.

sources.title: Azali Assoumani succeeds Sall as AU Chairperson, 18 February 2023
sources.findings: Read the AU February 18, 2023 succession announcement, confirming Azali Assoumani took over and Sall’s term ended that day. A label for the year 2022 does not mean tenure ended on December 31. Distinguish head-of-state rotating office from the permanent commission leadership.

sources.title: Election Delay in Senegal Puts Rights at Risk, 5 February 2024
sources.findings: Read Human Rights Watch’s February 5, 2024 substantive report on the February 3 election-delay announcement, protest policing, arrests, broadcasting restrictions and mobile-internet restrictions. Public wording attributes criticism to HRW and does not assert a personal criminal conviction or infer an individual command for every police action. Do not convert reported advocacy findings into an original judicial record.

sources.title: February 2024 election controversy and Constitutional Council ruling
sources.findings: Read International IDEA’s February 2024 substantive country update. It records the Constitutional Council’s February 15 ruling against the postponement and Sall’s following-day pledge to comply. The report uses February 6 for the parliamentary law while other reporting says February 5; the public narrative does not adopt an unverified precise legislative date. This update predates the actual March vote and April inauguration.

sources.title: Faye sworn in as Senegal president, 2 April 2024
sources.findings: Read the Reuters completed-inauguration account on April 2, 2024. Faye succeeds Sall after the actual March 24 election; Amadou Ba, not Sall himself, was the ruling coalition candidate. Do not present a pre-inauguration forecast as accession. Statements on later reforms are intentions, not completed achievements.

sources.title: March 2025 staff findings on fiscal and debt misreporting
sources.findings: Read the IMF March 26, 2025 mission findings concerning the February 12 audit and 2019–2023 deficit/debt underreporting. Audit/reconciliation and IMF misreporting procedures are not a criminal verdict against Sall. Debt ratios were revised again later, so no stale point estimate is presented as November 2026’s final figure. Original full Court of Auditors files and any criminal proceeding record were not inspected.

sources.title: Sall announces withdrawal from UN Secretary-General race, 17 October 2026
sources.findings: Read APS’s October 17, 2026 account quoting Sall’s public withdrawal declaration after the October 16 informal poll. Use announcement date October 17, distinct from October 20 formal withdrawal in the process account. Poll colour counts and alleged vetoes are not treated as officially published Security Council voting records; no appointment as UN chief is implied.

sources.title: Egyptian foreign minister receives former president Sall, 1 November 2026
sources.findings: Read the November 1, 2026 Le Progrès Egyptien report and foreign-ministry spokesperson attribution describing Abdel Aati receiving Sall that Sunday. This is actual personal meeting evidence, not a future invitation or a party statement about someone else. Discussion of UN candidacies and reform does not reverse the October withdrawal or establish a new candidacy. No photograph pixels or audio inspected.

sources.title: UN Secretary-General selection update: Sall withdrawal on 20 October 2026
sources.findings: Read IISD’s selection-process update, including Burundi’s March 2 nomination and October 20 withdrawal, with the UN official search index corroborating those dates. The October 17 personal announcement and later formal withdrawal are distinct. The report’s then-current candidate roster is not assumed complete on November 18. Full UN withdrawal letter retrieval returned 403, so no full primary-letter read is claimed.

Resolve the contextual significance of the source-use notice and avoid endorsement. One original download returned curl exit 22, 403, HTTP 000. The recorded 164742-byte cache data/research/cache/portraits/c3976b722d5b856f5810cb02.jpg is absent. Identity, colour, orientation, sharpness and framing remain unreviewed; no image pixels obtained.
